title: Show HN: High-quality duck audio synthesizer
summary: A web-based duck sound synthesizer that generates realistic quacking sounds using audio synthesis techniques, demonstrated through an interactive interface where users can control various parameters of the duck vocalizations.
problem_solved: Provides an accessible way to generate high-quality duck sounds for creative projects without needing recordings or sound libraries.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative audio synthesis capabilities in the browser while offering a practical tool for developers and content creators needing duck sounds.
